name: PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead answers for the demand PACE Yourself (YouTube) takes from the settlement signal board: it assesses each taken demand in the terms of the faces PACE Yourself (YouTube) serves, turns what is PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s work into work its own offices do, posts what another micro-enterprise does back on the board, and gives back what is not PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s work with its reasons. It staffs nothing outside PACE Yourself (YouTube), does not hand a signal to a chosen enterprise, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
